subject: Aligning console walkthrough & API key handoff
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finex.co>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jun 2028 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Aligning console walkthrough & API key handoff

Hi Alex —

Thanks for choosing Redwood for the pilot. Two quick coordination items before the kickoff: time and credentials. Attached is a short Console Prep Checklist (see attachment) that covers account access, IP allowlisting, and a short list of artifacts we’ll reference during the walkthrough.

Proposed 90-minute blocks (pick one):
- Wed Jun 14, 10:00–11:30 PT / 13:00–14:30 ET
- Thu Jun 15, 16:00–17:30 PT / 19:00–20:30 ET
- Fri Jun 16, 08:00–09:30 PT / 11:00–12:30 ET

If the team prefers, we can split into a 45-min console walkthrough and a 45–60 min API enablement session on a different day — say console first, API follow-up the next day. Let me know whether you need us to provision a sandbox API key in advance (temporary token) or if procurement is blocking keys right now — we can still do a console-only walkthrough and show the API flows with recorded examples.

Two asks before we lock a slot:
- Confirm preferred time slot and whether you want a split session or single block.
- Share any IP ranges to allow (or tell us if you need our security contact to open a ticket).

Attaching: Console-Prep-Checklist.pdf

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
https://redwood.com
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finex.co>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Rios <sam.rios@finex.co>
Date: Wed, 13 Jun 2028 09:21:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Aligning console walkthrough & API key handoff

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the checklist, that’s helpful. Quick heads-up: our product lead (Priya) is out on a customer sprint siege for the next two mornings, so morning slots are tough. Of your options the Thu Jun 15 evening slot (19:00 ET) would work better for our EMEA lead, but that’s late for some of our U.S. engineers.

Procurement hasn’t finished the sandbox key paperwork yet, so we don’t have a token to hand you. If you can provision a temporary, scoped sandbox key for the session that would let our infra engineer (Sam, cc’d) follow along. Otherwise we’re OK doing a console-first session and scheduling API enablement once the key is ready.

Sam: I’ll send the allowlist/IPs separately — we have a short change window on Thu afternoon.

On Wed, Jun 12, 2028 at 15:03, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Alex —
> 
> Thanks for choosing Redwood for the pilot. Two quick coordination items before the kickoff: time and credentials...

Appreciate the flexibility — Alex
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finex.co>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aligning console walkthrough & API key handoff

Alex —

Quick proposal to reduce scheduling pain: split the enablement into two focused sessions.
- Session A (45 min): Console walkthrough — inventory, role access, demo of common troubleshooting flows.
- Session B (60 min): API enablement — key exchange, sample calls, and a short hands-on lab.

Suggested slots (pick one pair):
- Thu Jun 15: Console 16:30 PT / API 17:30 PT (back-to-back) — keeps it on the same day but earlier than your 19:00 ET ask.
- Fri Jun 16: Console 08:00 PT / API 09:15 PT — morning US-friendly pair.

We can provision a time-limited sandbox key for Sam so you can follow the live API examples without procurement completing. I’ll attach a Mutual Action Plan (simple checklist + owners) so all parties have clear prework. If you want the security team looped (network allowlist), we can add our security engineer to the invite or request your IPs and apply them to the sandbox.

Meet link (provisional): https://meet.google.com/redwood-finex-onboard
Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx

If Thu 16:30 PT works we’ll send a calendar invite and reserve the sandbox token for Sam. Tessa — can you own the calendar invite and precall notes?

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finex.co>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Rios <sam.rios@finex.co>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jun 2028 09:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Aligning console walkthrough & API key handoff

Ben/Tessa —

Thanks — Thu Jun 15 works for the back-to-back option, Console at 16:30 PT and API at 17:30 PT. Please go ahead and send the invite; Sam will provide the three IP ranges by EOD today for allowlisting.

We’d prefer that the API session uses the temporary sandbox token so our infra lead can run the sample calls live. Also please include a short network checklist in the invite so our security folks know the exact items they need to approve.

Forwarding the proposed timing to my team — Sam will attach the IP list in a follow-up.

On Thu, Jun 14, 2028 at 11:05, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Alex —
> 
> Quick proposal to reduce scheduling pain: split the enablement into two focused sessions...

See you on Thu,
